item.title: Man with DOC escape warrant tied to murder conviction arrested in Tukwila, WA
item.description: A 57-year-old man with a Department of Corrections escape warrant for a first-degree murder conviction was arrested in Tukwila on Wednesday.

item.title: Seattle to see damp weather in the days ahead
item.description: We’re tracking a slight uptick in rain chances on Sunday, and it could be a bit breezy at times. Then by Monday and Tuesday, noticeably cooler air settles in.

item.title: Washington receives $668 million to clean Duwamish River of toxic chemicals
item.description: Washington secured a $668 million settlement to clean toxic chemicals from Seattle’s Lower Duwamish Waterway.

item.title: Seattle Metro Chamber CEO says diversification is key for future economic growth
item.description: Seattle business leaders say the city's economy is facing pressure over rapid shifts driven by artificial intelligence, triggering mass tech layoffs.

item.title: WA bill to strengthen laws against child sex abuse heads to governor's desk
item.description: A new bill aimed at strengthening Washington’s child sex abuse laws, particularly involving sexually explicit generative AI content, is now headed to the governor’s desk.

item.title: WA Gov. Ferguson cancels parole of convicted rapist who previously fled state
item.description: Washington Governor Bob Ferguson stepped in to cancel the parole of a serial rapist who was slated for release after serving 40 years of a life sentence.

item.title: All northbound lanes of Seattle's SR 99 First Avenue bridge to close for 3 days
item.description: Seattle's First Avenue South bridge, already experiencing lane closures, will permanently close for several days as crews complete temporary repairs.

item.title: Seattle Torrent lose 4-3 to Charge for fourth straight defeat
item.description: Fanuza Kadirova scored a pair of goals for Ottawa – including the game-winning goal with 1:46 left to play – as the Charge beat the Seattle Torrent for their fourth straight loss on Wednesday night.

item.title: Gig Harbor, WA community remembers 4 women killed in Key Peninsula stabbing
item.description: The Gig Harbor community gathered Wednesday night to honor a mother and three neighbors killed in a stabbing on Feb. 24.

item.title: Seattle Kraken deliver dud in 3-2 loss to Blues ahead of trade deadline
item.description: The Kraken scored just 31 seconds into Wednesday night's game against the Blues before falling apart in a 3-2 loss that keeps the team in firm limbo ahead of Friday's 12 p.m. PT NHL trade deadline.
